revisions.prompt: Edit this single coin still life. Preserve the silver coin's size, angle, edge, surface color, wood background and watercolor/ink style. Make the coin face so heavily worn that its central bust, facial profile, laurel and any letters are almost completely rubbed away into vague flattened silver relief. No recognizable ruler face, laurel crown, dates, letters, denomination or exact die design. It must remain one old silver coin, not a blank modern token; faint irregular worn traces only. No other objects, text or signature.
